    Transfer of the mesh derivative to a τ-closed full subquiver #

    Proof of Proposition 5.1 (prop:periodic-localization), last paragraph, and eq:mesh-object-quotient. For a τ-closed set S, the inclusion kQ_S → kQ sends the mesh relation of Q_S at x to the mesh relation of Q at x minus its terms through middle vertices outside S (inclL_meshRelation_sub_mem). Hence the inclusion maps the mesh ideal of Q_S into the mesh ideal of Q plus the paths through vertices outside S (inclL_mem_ideal_sup_outside).

    Consequently, if D_m(C(Q_S)) is surjective and the rows through vertices outside S are already in the image of D_m(C(Q)), then every row at a vertex of S is in that image (row_mem_imageD_of_restrict).
